title: Facet Agent API
description: JSON schemas for Facet MCP tool inputs and outputs

description.description: Human-readable description of what the tool does

inputSchema.description: JSON Schema for the tool's input parameters

namespace.description: Tool namespace / MCP server name, e.g. github, filesystem

id.description: Cluster identifier, e.g. git, filesystem, notion

tokens.description: Total token cost for tools in this cluster

facet_plan_surface.description: Select a task-specific subset of tools under a token budget

task.description: The current agent goal or subtask description. More specific = better routing.
examples: fix the login validation bug in auth middleware
create a pull request for the bugfix branch

tools.description: Full tool manifest. Required unless manifestId is provided.

manifestId.description: ID returned by facet_register_manifest. Use this to avoid resending the full manifest.

budget.description: Maximum token budget for the returned tool surface. Recommended: 4000–8000.

profile.description: Named profile from facet.json. Applies pin/block/prefer constraints.

selected.description: Tools to use for this subtask — these fit within the token budget and are relevant to the task

deferred.description: Tools not surfaced this turn — re-plan when the task shifts to access them

tokensBefore.description: Total tokens if all tools were sent (baseline)

tokensAfter.description: Actual tokens consumed by the selected surface

savingsPercent.description: Percentage of tokens saved: (before - after) / before * 100

reasons.description: Per-tool reason string explaining why it was selected or deferred

facet_audit_tools.description: Audit token cost and capability clusters for a tool manifest

facet_register_manifest.description: Cache a full tool manifest server-side for the session

id.description: Optional custom manifest ID. Auto-generated if omitted.
